thread:
violet-docs: I opened a short PR to clarify SOC2-friendly retention wording, add a tiny pseudonymization example, and include compact SDK snippets (py/ts/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6201

sam-security: Thanks. Two quick notes: avoid 'we keep' or 'indefinitely' language; use passive/neutral phrasing for retention. Also note exported datasets are access-controlled and audited.

violet-docs: Draft line: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; exports created to satisfy legal or contractual obligations may be retained for longer.' Ok?

sam-security: That looks good. Add a one-line contact for legal holds.

lee-eng: Pushed tiny examples for the doc: python, ts (async), and curl. Python sample (sampling): ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
c = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = c.query_events(sample=0.01, start='2025-04-01', end='2025-04-30')
print(resp['total'])
```

violet-docs: Added legal contact: legal@redwood.com and a pseudonymized example (illustrative): `{ "user_id": "sha256:9a8f...", "event": "model.run", "ts": "2025-04-10T10:00:00Z" }`

maria-legal: Phrase 'as required by law or contractual obligations' preferred. Also note: sampled queries are for operational triage and can under-represent rare anomalies; recommend full export for investigations.

violet-docs: Added the legal wording and sampling bias callout, and asked bot-ci to run linkcheck.

bot-ci: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6201/files — reviewers requested: @sam-security @maria-legal @lee-eng

violet-docs: Thanks all. Will merge after security + legal ACK and passing linkcheck.
